summary: Earned constraints: delivery gates belong to the dispatcher, not to each transport, so a queue, a MAF host, and SendMessage cannot each enforce a different policy; runtime limits are read from .pmcro configuration and never accepted as caller arguments, because a caller-supplied limit is not a limit; idempotency keys are required on any message crossing an at-least-once transport; and control-plane scripts stay stdlib-only so validation runs on a machine with no package installs.
